title: Water Damage Mitigation Insured's Share on Insurance-Funded Jobs
content:
On an insurance-funded Water Damage Mitigation job, the insured pays the company directly for the part of the job's charges that the claim's dwelling coverage does not pay: the insured's share.

## Rule
Only an insurance claim job linked to a claim file carries an insured's share, and the job must not be closed when the insured pays it; the insured's share is the insured's own payment, made by the insured through the company's secure payment channel, and staff never take card numbers.

The insured's share of a job whose drying is complete and whose final invoice has not yet been issued, and that carries pad removal or carpet removal lines, is fixed only after the job carries a HEPA vacuuming line.

## At a glance
| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Which jobs | insurance claim jobs linked to a claim file; a self-pay job carries no insured's share |
| Job status | any status except closed |
| Who pays | the insured, personally, through the secure payment channel; staff never take card numbers |

## Paying through the secure payment channel
`pay_insured_share_cc172b06` is a customer-owned tool: the desk agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it through the company's secure payment channel. On success one customer payment is posted in full to the named insurance-funded job with the chosen tender, a processor confirmation number is issued, and the job's balance due falls by the amount; the customer sees the confirmation number and the new balance.

### Parameters
- `water_job_id` — the reference number of the customer's water mitigation job, which the desk agent reads from the water mitigation job lookup and gives to the customer before the payment.
- `payment_method` — the tender the customer pays with, exactly one of: `credit_card` (a credit card), `debit_card` (a debit card), `ach` (a bank transfer from a checking or savings account) or `check` (a paper or electronic check).
- `amount` — the amount paid in USD, a positive amount with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent half up before the call.

### Return
On success the tool returns a text receipt of the form "Payment posted: <amount> USD by <tender> to job <job reference>, confirmation <confirmation number>, payment reference <payment reference>; balance due now <balance> USD.", where the confirmation number is the processor confirmation issued for this payment, the payment reference is the new payment line's reference number and the balance is the job's balance due after the payment. The payment has succeeded when the receipt starts with "Payment posted". A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was paid: the tender was not one of the four listed, the amount was not positive or carried more than 2 decimal places, or no water mitigation job has that reference number.
